Rumor has it that Apple has been working on a major revamp of its Home lineup for years, and a new leak has now surfaced listing the products we should expect.

macOS Code Leak Mentions Several Unreleased Home Devices

Apple's most important annual event is just weeks away, and it's expected to debut multiple new Home products alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, new Apple Watch models, and more.

Rumors point to an all-new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad. But there are several other Home products that could also be on the way.

MacRumors discovered yesterday that the newly released macOS 26.7 RC contains references to a number of unreleased products.

Among them are codenames related to Home devices. According to Juli Clover:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is believed to be a home hub version with a base, while J491 is designed to be mounted on a wall."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): The current HomePod mini is codenamed B520, so this is likely the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): Likely the rumored security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Newly mentioned unknown Home devices.
  • ATVRemote1,5: Next-generation Siri Remote, expected to launch alongside a new Apple TV 4K.

Other rumored Home products in the works include a video doorbell and a desktop robotic home hub. It's unclear whether their codenames are included in the macOS 26.7 leak.

Beyond products, MacRumors also found a codename "Pebble," believed to be the internal name for homeOS. There's also a string "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning" that could be related to HomePad.

Finally, the leak also reveals an unspecified Home accessory available in four colors: Rose Pink, Silver, Space Gray, and Starlight.
